messages:
maria: Hey runtime — marketing needs a bench audit pack to support the launch blog + press. Can we get a reproducible run + artifacts that substantiate our latency & cost claims by EOD tomorrow? Key asks:
- methodology doc (what we measured, why)
- raw run logs + consolidated results (CSV/JSON)
- per-slice p50/p95/p99 latency and throughput (by seq-length cohort)
- token-level cost calc & billing assumptions
- 40 representative input/output samples (unredacted)
- the exact run command + env (so we can reproduce)
We also need a one-paragraph explainer for press/legal. embargo until next Tue AM.

sam: Thanks — can you confirm the exact model/config and the traffic profile? e.g., short answers vs long chat vs embedding calls. Also: do you need cold-start runs?

maria: Profile we want: 60% short reply (<=64 tokens), 30% long chat (avg 256, tail up to 1024), 10% embeddings (seq 128). Model target: redwood-13b-quant (int4) and redwood-13b-fp16 as fallback. Include both quantized and FP runs. Yes include cold-start + warmed pool (cold = fresh instance, warm = after 5 concurrent reqs).

jin: For reproducibility, I'll request we include the exact RNG seed and the run script. Example that would be ideal to include in artifacts:
```bash
./run_bench --model redwood-13b-quant --seq_dist "short:0.6,medium:0.3,long:0.1" --seq_long_max 1024 --batch 8 --seed 42 --warmup 5 --out results.json
```
Also include the Docker image tag / commit sha and CUDA/drivers info.

sam: Got it. We'll run dedi pool sweep with both quant and fp16, cold + warm for each, and capture per-token timings (tokenization, forward, kv cache). Will include: commit sha=abc123def, cuda=12.1, pytorch=2.2, runtime image=redwood/runtime:2026-03-21-rc. ETA ~12 hours from now. We'll also annotate results with campaign_id=launch_apr.

oliver: Add to asks: tag any failed responses and include the failure rate per slice, plus sample traces for 5 failures (stack + logs). Legal wants a short blurb about measurement boundaries — please keep that ready.

deploy-bot: bench-sweep job 4387654321-1 started on pool:dedi-32g (queued -> running).

sam: Quick note on batching: we'll run two batch configs (batch=1 and batch=8) and show how unit cost changes. Cost calc will use our standard token-price assumptions (gpu-minute cost + amortized infra) and include the math in a single-sheet CSV.

deploy-bot: bench-sweep job 4387654321-1 completed OK. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/4387654321/4387654321-1-results.json, s3://redwood-bench/4387654321/methodology.md, s3://redwood-bench/4387654321/run.sh, s3://redwood-bench/4387654321/summary.csv

maria: Amazing — please drop the artifacts link here and a 1-paragraph measurement blurb for legal/press. Also include any caveats (e.g., warm pool assumptions, synthetic vs live input).

sam: Uploaded. Links above. Measurement blurb (for press/legal): "Latency and cost numbers were measured on dedicated GPU pools using a stratified traffic profile (short, medium, long). We report p50/p95/p99 across 10k requests per slice; cost estimates combine GPU runtime + infra amortization. Cold-starts were measured on fresh instances; warm runs were captured after 5 concurrent warmup requests. Full run scripts and raw logs are provided for reproducibility."

maria: Perfect — tagging legal and product for signoff. Thanks everyone :pray:
